d: This is Taste or Toss, a show where celebrities will have to make the tough choice to pick between their favorite Latino foods.
Pero Like brings the heat as friends and creators take on spicy challenges, viral food trends, and country-versus-country battles to find out who really wins at the table.
Latina moms taste-test traditional dishes and new foods, swapping family recipes, trying unfamiliar flavors, and sharing unfiltered opinions you can only get from moms.
Latino dads taste-test traditional dishes and home-cooked meals, swapping family favorites, reacting to new takes on classic recipes, and sharing honest opinions only dads can give.

d: Tasty chefs test out the latest and most talked-about kitchen gadgets, from viral air fryers to questionable single-purpose tools.
